sections.h2: Industrials, Engineering & Auto is the largest filer sector, at 14% of companies

chart.title: Industrials, Engineering & Auto has more filer companies than any other sector
chart.sub: Companies with at least one SEBI DRHP filing, by sector, Aug 2019 to Aug 2026.
chart.source: SEBI public-issue filings register; sector grouping is this analysis's own.

sections.means: The sector that gets the least coverage is the one with the most companies on file.
sections.todo: Readers tracking India's IPO pipeline should look beyond consumer-tech names to industrial filers.

sections.h2: 2026 has already passed 2023 as the record year for SEBI filings

chart.title: Filings reached 99 by 27 August, past 2023's 97 with four months left
chart.sub: SEBI public-issue filings per year (DRHP, Updated DRHP, Addendum, Corrigendum); 2026 runs to 27 August.
chart.source: SEBI public-issue filings register, Aug 2019 to 27 Aug 2026.

sections.means: Filing volume rose from one filing in 2019 to a plateau of 80 to 100 a year from 2023 onward.
sections.todo: Anyone counting the pipeline should compare 2026 against the full-year records, not a partial year.

sections.h2: Most filer companies have not gone beyond their initial DRHP

chart.title: Two in three of the 391 filers have never filed an amendment to their DRHP
chart.sub: Companies by latest filing stage, Aug 2019 to Aug 2026.
chart.source: SEBI public-issue filings register, Aug 2019 to 27 Aug 2026.

sections.means: Most companies on file are still early in the process, with the observation letter valid for only 12 months.
sections.todo: Treat a DRHP on file as a company that has started the process, and check its observation-letter date before expecting a listing.
